ecosystems.name: Heat-pump replacement / legacy maintenance
ecosystems.definition: Large and rapidly expanding heat-pump stock embedded in an ageing fossil-heating building base; strongest opportunity is consumer-safe lifecycle/compatibility tails, not generic new systems.
falsifiers: OEM/service partners already satisfy all consumer-safe jobs
ecosystems.next_action: Freeze top brands/legacy models, measure DE/FR/IT native exact-model query forests and Swiss good-seller coverage; only then request dealer terms.

ecosystems.name: Solar + battery lifecycle / integration
ecosystems.definition: PV is system-scale while battery stock is expanding extremely quickly; falling storage cost and new tariff/self-consumption incentives create retrofit/integration jobs, but generic batteries are already visible in price comparison.
falsifiers: Toppreise census shows target depth equal source
ecosystems.next_action: Build installed inverter/battery brand cohort proxies; compare German/Italian/French catalogue depth to Swiss exact-model accessory/retrofit coverage and query demand.

ecosystems.name: Emerging EV model-cohort aftermarket
ecosystems.definition: BEV penetration continues rising and ASTRA exposes model-level data; opportunity must come from a new model cohort growing faster than Swiss exact-fit assortment, with XPeng G6 already showing specialist response as a negative-control warning.
ecosystems.next_action: Extract exact model stock/registrations from ASTRA; precommit fastest-growing cohorts and compare Swiss vs German/global assortment before any SKU research.

ecosystems.name: E-bike battery / parts lifecycle
ecosystems.definition: Large estimated e-bike fleet and continued annual deliveries imply replacement demand, but Swiss battery repair, retailer and parts coverage is already deep; generic battery/parts commerce is a negative control.
falsifiers: generic batteries already price-competitive and well served
ecosystems.next_action: Use Switzerland as mature oracle/negative control. Only investigate obsolete battery/BMS/connector models where legal/safety handling and exact demand are measurable.

ecosystems.name: Radon + renovation measurement
ecosystems.definition: Official 1km risk mapping and a 300 Bq/m³ reference level create real need, especially around energy renovations, but generic monitors are broadly available; service/content/post-renovation workflows are more interesting than meter resale.
falsifiers: recognized service providers own all value
ecosystems.next_action: Kill generic monitor resale. Test multilingual renovation/radon decision content and recognized-measurement lead-gen only after native query economics.

ecosystems.name: Home-energy retrofit / technical diagnostics
ecosystems.definition: 1.79m residential buildings, >1m single-family houses and >CHF636m committed renovation support create a durable technical-product/job surface; Switzerland-specific value may come from multilingual compatibility and customs-ready fulfilment rather than product novelty.
falsifiers: Digitec/Galaxus and Swiss specialists already cover target
ecosystems.next_action: Enumerate exact diagnostic/retrofit equipment ecosystems from German/French/Italian source markets; require Swiss merchant/cost gap plus language-specific query demand.

product_markets.name: Heat-pump legacy filters / consumer-safe compatibility parts
product_markets.thesis: Large replacement wave, but OEM/service channels are strong; only exact legacy consumer-safe cells can survive.
product_markets.next_action: Freeze 30 legacy model/consumable cells across German/French/Italian regions and compare DE/AT source assortment before economics outreach.

product_markets.name: SolarEdge / home-battery exact retrofit accessories
product_markets.thesis: Battery installed base is expanding rapidly while exact SolarEdge product snapshots show only narrow offer counts; test accessories/comms/retrofit cells, never generic batteries.
product_markets.next_action: Freeze exact part universe and German/Italian source catalogue; collect Toppreise/Shopping sellers, then dealer terms.

product_markets.name: Generic home battery ecommerce
product_markets.thesis: Huge growth does not imply whitespace; generic systems require installation and are broadly compared/supplied.
product_markets.next_action: Use generic battery market as installed-base source and negative control; mine exact lifecycle/integration tails instead.

product_markets.name: XPeng G6 generic exact-model accessories
product_markets.thesis: A visible Swiss specialist already maintains a dedicated G6 collection; not an obvious merchant-lag cell.
product_markets.next_action: Use G6 as negative control; extract ASTRA cohorts to find models without equivalent Swiss specialists.

product_markets.name: Next emerging BEV cohort exact-fit accessories
product_markets.thesis: ASTRA makes exact cohort discovery possible; identify a fast-growing model before Swiss specialist assortment catches up.
product_markets.next_action: Generate precommitted top-20 model cohorts from ASTRA; score source-target catalogue lag without cherry-picking.

product_markets.name: Generic Bosch e-bike battery / parts ecommerce
product_markets.thesis: Swiss market already has offer density, specialist repair, hazardous-goods handling and deep Bosch parts catalogues.
product_markets.next_action: Use as negative control and source-market merchant archetype; no generic store.

product_markets.name: Generic consumer radon monitor store
product_markets.thesis: Official need is real but local specialist + marketplace + price-comparison supply falsifies generic monitor whitespace.
product_markets.next_action: Test post-renovation measurement/service workflows separately; no generic meter store.

product_markets.name: Multilingual old-home diagnostic / retrofit equipment specialist
product_markets.thesis: The potential edge is not generic tools; it is Swiss customs-ready, multilingual decision support around building-renovation problems with source-market catalogues from DE/FR/IT.
product_markets.next_action: Mine mature DE/FR/IT building-diagnostics merchants, freeze 50 exact products/jobs, compare Swiss merchant quality and landed economics.
